title: Surabaya Orthopedic Half Marathon 2026 Review: A Medical-Themed 21K
seo_title: Surabaya Orthopedic HM 2026 Review | SOHM Indonesia Race
meta_description: The Surabaya Orthopedic Half Marathon (SOHM) 2026: September 13 at Pakuwon City. 21K to 5K with registration open from Rp 137.5K — a unique medical-themed Indonesian race.
dek: Set for 13 September 2026 at The Caribbean Grande Pakuwon City in Surabaya, this orthopedic-themed half marathon offers three distances with registration open from Rp 137.5K–450K. Possibly the only orthopedic-branded road race in Southeast Asia.
verdict: The Surabaya Orthopedic Half Marathon (SOHM) carries perhaps the most distinctive medical theme in Southeast Asian road racing — an orthopedic-branded half marathon with a clear health-and-wellness positioning. Three distances (21K, 10K, 5K) with registration open from Rp 137.5K–450K (roughly USD 9–29). The Caribbean Grande Pakuwon City is a modern waterfront development in Surabaya, providing a flat, well-venued course. For runners wanting an affordable, themed Indonesian half marathon in East Java's capital, this is a distinctive and bookable pick.

sections.heading: SOHM: The Orthopedic Run
paragraphs: The orthopedic theme gives this race a unique medical-branding identity — likely with health-screening booths, posture clinics, and injury-prevention content at the race village. [1] Pakuwon City is a waterfront development in East Surabaya with wide roads and modern infrastructure. The pricing (from Rp 137.5K for 5K) makes it one of the more affordable Indonesian half marathons.
